name: upskill
description: Upskill: a coach's view of who is on track and who is at risk

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,blue "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:migrate -w server && npm run db:seed -w server
